correctness.rationale: From exact state-transition definitions, the two- and three-state subgenerators give finite-state discounted survival via linear resolvents. Algebra yields b*q*(z+e+b+ell)*P(z)/(Dp*Dc), with P having strictly positive coefficients and determinants positive from transience for every z>=0. At ell=1/10,e=3,b=q=1, exact means are 61/203 and 469/1712. Uniformization rate 8 at t=2 yields a rational scaled survival-difference partial sum W80<-90 while the entire omitted absolute tail is less than 1/1000, proving reversal at the deterministic deadline. CHECK.py replays 127 symbolic/exact rational assertions, including an independently built 5-state generator. No empirical/general-N extension is asserted.

value.rationale: The ecological source directly motivates dispersal timing in ephemeral habitats under matched colonization intensity. This is a complete all-rate structural statement for the smallest connected habitat landscape that supports recolonization, not an arbitrary numerical slice: it distinguishes mean and exponential-deadline persistence from fixed-deadline risk. The exact counterexample shows why a mathematically proven mean advantage cannot be interpreted as universal temporal-risk mitigation. Two-patch and idealized Markov restrictions are clear.
